_meta.status: PROPOSED - NOT FROZEN. Freezes only after Eli approves the set. Do not run the paid baseline until then.
_meta.purpose: Synthetic input set for the LinkedIn-outreach (generate-linkedin-outreach-message) quality eval. Once frozen, future rounds score the SAME set so before/after numbers are comparable. Add inputs only as a versioned append (new id), never by mutating an existing one.
_meta.why_synthetic: linkedin_outreach_conversations has 1 distinct (internal) user, 7 threaded rows, all dated 2026-05-06..2026-06-02 - PRE-date the current framework (they contain phrases the current H1/H3 now ban: 'for the summer', 'moderate bridge', 'if it'd be useful'). And message_thread stores only the user's SENT (post-edit) text + recipient replies, never the raw model suggestion. So real data cannot measure the current generator; these hand-authored inputs span the diversity we expect from Reichman business-student pilot users.
diversity_axes: goal: all 9 live goals (message_recruiter, message_hiring_manager, message_alumni, request_informational_interview, thank_you_follow_up, reconnect_dormant, ask_for_referral, ask_for_recommendation, propose_internship)
relationship warmth: cold / warm / dormant / strong
mutual_context richness: rich (specific shared event+detail) / sparse (bare fact) / null - the lever that probes fabricated-familiarity
recipient register: casual Israeli alum / formal multinational VP / recruiter
profile depth: thin (undergrad, club only) / strong (real CS role)
practicum gate: in_practicum true+Reichman (gate open) / in_practicum false (gate must suppress the program claim)
_meta.grounding_convention: user_data mirrors what index.ts assembles from profiles/experiences/stories/internship_profiles/educations. It is the ONLY source of groundable facts about the SENDER. target_person.mutual_context is the ONLY source of groundable facts about the RECIPIENT - anything specific about the recipient NOT in mutual_context is fabrication.
_meta.field_notes: expect_path (referral only) marks the intended Path A/B. thread + new_them_reply drive continuing-turn modes. target_company null = registry miss (framework must fall back to sector/stage, not invent).
